decisions.reason: The left action uses inverse coordinate permutations. With y_i=x_sigma(i), the acting permutation is kappa sigma^{-1} kappa^{-1}; the displayed coordinate calculation now proves the orbit/subset bijection, including n=0 and n=1. Quotient topology and the free action are unchanged.

The claimed open/complement pasting rule is false and leaves boundary continuity unproved. The repair uses the open cover V_j and M minus K_j, where K_j is the chart image of the compact closed radius-2rho ball; the chart mover and inverse agree with the identity on the overlap. The contraction bound 1/2 gives a bijection and the inverse-family estimate gives joint continuity. Also corrected the ill-typed exported equation to pi composed with Phi = pr_1. Finite choices and choice-free Euclidean compactness suffice.

Equivariance preserves target orbits, not individual ordered tuples. Step 4.2 now factors p_int composed with rho^F through p_D, as the quotient universal property requires. The independent check also found reversed boundary paths in step 1.4; A now follows bottom then right and B left then top, proving G_0*c homotopic to c*G_1 with endpoints fixed. Positive scaling preserves distinct points; open quotient products and path conjugation then prove all three unchanged claims.

The cited endpoint-permutation definition is restricted to the disk, while this example allows any two plane points. Its actual lift computation is valid: gamma never vanishes and the lift ends at (q_2,q_1). Defined sigma_alpha locally by q.[alpha]=sigma_alpha.q using the existing general covering monodromy, and removed the disk-only dependency. The free two-point action makes that permutation unique, and the transposition proves the covering nontrivial.

Parallel arrows with the same endpoints are distinct path generators, so a vertex list alone does not define the stated general path ring. Paths now retain specified arrows and concatenation retains those labels; vertex-only notation remains valid for the doubled line. Also corrected the reversed left/right ideal descriptions and the swapped sides in the unit calculation. Associativity follows from concatenating arrow lists; endpoint blocks and the empty zero ring satisfy the same identities. Khovanov-Seidel section 1b distinguishes arbitrary paths from doubled-line vertex tuples.

A nonzero length-two product in the path ring can be monotone, so the old return-only case split did not prove rho(I_m)=0. The replacement treats monotone generators and the zero return separately; for a return difference both summands have the same endpoints, hence vertex multiplication kills both or retains both and their rho-images cancel. Longer products map to zero by definition. Also bounded the upward-return formula to i<m. Length-three reduction and the inverse linear maps establish the unchanged graded 4m+1 basis, including m=1.

L3 listed the impossible return (m|m+1|m); the basis supplier instead gives (i|i-1|i) for 1<=i<=m. Corrected this citation. The proof uses finite freeness, not the erroneous representative: finite Z-rank implies left and right Noetherianity, degreewise kernels remain finitely generated, and multiplication by the degree-zero e_i splits each vertex projective. Internal shifts preserve finite generation and have inverse shift {-r}; all Definition claims remain unchanged.

F1 shifted only the monotone relations while retaining 0<j<m, omitting (0|1|2) and mentioning vertex m+1. Restored (j-1|j|j+1) and its reverse. Every actual ideal generator is a length-two path or a difference of such paths and acts by zero on S_i, so the action descends. Also made the endpoint omissions in the displayed projective quotient explicit and corrected the exactness explanation: multiplication by p is injective, its image is pZ, and reduction modulo p is onto.

At q=0 the old vertical formula can be nonzero although its codomain is zero; all maps with zero source or target are now explicitly zero. Checked each boundary square: p=0 or q=0 has zero target, j=0 uses (0|1|0)=0, and all remaining squares use interior return equality. Corrected F1 relation indices, L3 return representatives, path lengths, H_0 as quotient by im d_1, and the i=m bottom-row case. Basis calculations give exact positive column degrees and bottom homology S_i; acyclic assembly and the cone exact sequence then resolve S_i and S_i/pS_i.

For H on R^p tensor X^q, applying H after d_R uses the new first index p+1, giving coefficient (-1)^(p+1), not (-1)^p(-1)^(p+1). Corrected Hd; its cross term now cancels the (-1)^p term of dH for every integer p, leaving id tensor (d h+h d). Also corrected the explanation in 4.4: k lowers p to p-1, which supplies the opposite cross sign. Boundedness, balanced linearity, internal shifts and d squared were checked and the Definition is unchanged.

The internal shift reindexes graded pieces; it preserves the underlying ungraded group, not a degree-preserving isomorphism M isomorphic to M{r}. Corrected L3. The witness remains valid because P_i{1} is a nonzero one-term complex in degree 0 and P_i[1] is in degree -1, so every chain map between them is zero and the identity of the source cannot be nullhomotopic. Clarified that morphisms are homotopy classes and did not infer inequality of K_0 operators without a basis computation.

Multiplication preserves the endpoint vertex i; the old A_l P_i subset P_(i+l) confuses that index with internal degree and fails on the nonzero return at vertex 1. Replaced it with (A_m)_l(P_i)_d subset (P_i)_(l+d), and checked the analogous right action. Homogeneous finite Z-bases split U_i into finite sums of shifted vertex projectives on either side, giving right flatness and projective preservation. Added the finite-generator surjection argument for the stated endofunctor and corrected the single neighbor m-1 at the upper endpoint.

Right multiplication by a descending path changes internal degree, so L4 was too broad; restricted it to degree-zero paths from j to k, which includes both actual differentials. Explicit images are u_0,r_1 for P_0 to P_1 and u_1,r_2 for P_1 to P_2, giving exactness by basis independence. Corrected the erroneous lengths of the killed paths, justified the augmentation by ae_2 mapping to a.1, and limited the projectivity claim to P_0,P_1,P_2 rather than S_2. The resolution and Example are unchanged.
